name: partymaker
description: PartyMaker - plan parties, manage guest lists, and track RSVPs.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
